zh-CN.title: 法显求法路线
zh-CN.subtitle: 长安—南亚—归返的跨区域知识流动
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这条路线把法显的求法记录与长安、敦煌、鹿野苑、那烂陀等现实地点放入同一研究视野。
curatorialDescription: 路线只连接有地理参照的区域节点，不绘制伪精确的逐日轨迹。
zh-CN.researchNote: 航海段、具体停留时长与文本段落定位需继续补充。

en.title: Faxian's pilgrimage route
en.subtitle: Transregional knowledge movement from Chang'an through South Asia and back
en.shortSummary: The route places Faxian's pilgrimage record alongside real places such as Chang'an, Dunhuang, Sarnath and Nalanda.
curatorialDescription: It connects regional geographic anchors without drawing a falsely precise day-by-day track.
en.researchNote: Maritime segments, stop durations and passage-level locations remain to be added.

corridorNote.zh-CN: 只列现实地理锚点，不把区域路线重建伪装成逐日行程。
corridorNote.en: Only real geographic anchors are shown; a regional reconstruction is not presented as a day-by-day itinerary.
